notes.title: [DEMO VERSION] Patch Release
notes.content:
We have confirmed an issue in the Steam version where, on certain PC environments, the screen whites out and the game cannot proceed.
Today, Friday, September 12th at around 3:00 PM JST, we released a patch that resolves some of these issues.
If the issue persists, please try the following settings:


 Change your display refresh rate to 144Hz or lower in your Windows system settings
 Use a standard keyboard layout, not a custom one

We will continue investigating other potential causes.
Thank you for your continued support of Digimon Story Time Stranger.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1984270/_/

notes.title: Digimon Story Time Stranger - System Trailer 🎬
notes.content:
This begins your report from the ADAMAS Special Investigation Bureau. Let’s learn more about the Phase Electron Lifeforms known as Digimon! 

[previewyoutube="XhorF0AKiAQ;full"][/previewyoutube]
 
Obtaining DigimonScan Digimon in battle to convert Digimon equivalent of DNA into binary code and create more Digimon! 

Training DigimonEquip Skills and Equipment to strengthen your Digimon. Achieve certain conditions to Digivolve Digimon into other forms. 

DigifarmA place where Digimon can grow and train on their own. Give them food to increase bonds! 

Agent SkillsGain Anomaly Points to unlock abilities for your Digimon. 

BattlesMaster the synergies between Attributes and Elements to be victorious in battle. Agents can assist in battle with Cross Arts to turn the tide.  Stay focused on the mission and keep investigating these anomalies.  Travel across time and parallel worlds in this turn-based RPG when Digimon Story Time Stranger releases October 3rd, 2025.

Read the full details HERE

notes.title: Release Date Trailer has been revealed!
notes.content:
Digimon Story Time Stranger, the latest installment in the "Digimon Story" series, is set to release on Steam on October 3, 2025! Keep an eye on the Steam page as the preorder will be opening soon.

[previewyoutube=JRCH0qPHYzo;full][previewyoutube=JRCH0qPHYzo;leftthumb][/previewyoutube][/previewyoutube]
 
Embark on an adventure that spans across the human world and Digital World, collecting and raising a diverse array of Digimon to fight in turn-based battles. 

Tokyo, Japan – Become an agent of a secret organization who encounters an unknown creature shortly before an explosion levels the city. You'll reawaken eight years in the past, unraveling the mystery of the world's collapse while exploring the deep bond between humans and Digimon.


AVAILABLE ON 3 OCTOBER 2025
